notes.title: Update 1.4.0
notes.content:
We are excited to introduce the latest update to our game, version 1.4.0! With this update, we bring several significant improvements to make your gaming experience even more exciting and engaging.

We have added support for 7 new languages, which means you can now enjoy the game in an even greater variety of languages. The languages include:
• English
• Brazilian Portuguese
• French
• Italian
• German
• Spanish
• Korean
• Japanese
• Russian

To make your journey through the game even more captivating, we have made graphical adjustments, resulting in more vibrant colors and visually appealing graphics. 
https://i.imgur.com/NkIsIJe.png

And we have great news for players seeking top-notch performance! The game now supports frame rates of up to 120 FPS, providing an extremely smooth and responsive gaming experience. Get ready for more intense action and smoother movements!
[previewyoutube=IuIxQs21wZc;full][/previewyoutube]

As the icing on the cake, we are thrilled to announce that our game will also be launching on the Epic Games Store. This means your achievements will count towards your Epic Games profile, making it a perfect game for achievement hunters!
Check it out: https://store.epicgames.com/p/space-elite-force-a00006

Have Fun!

Alysson N. Moraes,
Rising Moon Games.

 Camera zoom option. now you can zoom in and out of the camera using the + and - keys on the keyboard or w, s, up arrow and down arrow.
 Position of the locomotive button, now the button that starts the train is positioned in the lower center of the screen.

notes.title: Space Elite Force II - Released on Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/3d0b8c48d55a8e278648fdccbeee07d579fdb02b.gif

Space Elite Force II is a space-shooting game for up to 2 players in local cooperative mode.

With a wide variety of weapons, enemies and improvements to your ship, it presents all the intensity, depth and beautiful handcrafted pixels of a classic space-shooting game. Have fun in insane battles, facing epic bosses and unlocking a wide variety of achievements in one of three game modes, alone or with a friend in local cooperative mode.

https://media.giphy.com/media/LqrgIn9VTadi0p6TdU/giphy.gif

Game Details:
- Fast and intense phases.
- Insane battles against epic bosses
- Play with a friend in local cooperative mode! (Requires at least one joystick)
- Beautiful visuals made with handmade pixels.
- Online ranking for each game mode.
- Available in 2 languages (English, Portuguese)

https://media.giphy.com/media/dy9v8y3ttDTlopxyYF/giphy.gif
Game modes:
- Normal Mode: classic game experience, immerse yourself in the immersive story of Space Elite Force and try to recover the data stolen by the merciless and hostile Klyvu race
- Arcade Mode: A frantic and fun mode for those who want fast and intense matches, survive as long as you can with your chosen weapons at the start.
- Boss Rush Mode: Try to defeat all the bosses, one by one, and get the best score in the ranking ... this will not be easy!

get on Nintendo eShop HERE.

Att,

notes.title: Space Elite Force - Update 1.3.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32717079/6a154570098bdb13c18376004b022bf80b08d0f8.png
After the launch of Space Elite Force II, we also decided to bring improvements to Space Elite Force I. Version 1.3.0 brings significant technical and mainly improvements to the game's visuals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32717079/651f5f08ab52ed45c6cdc77d56fe55af179b1d3b.gif

Graphics
after comparing Space Elite Force I with Space Elite Force II, we realized that there was a big difference in graphics quality. So we dedicate a little bit of our time to improve that in the game too. See below some screenshots of before and after:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32717079/d162d2ca82955e5c60c993784dc6ab87bc4de73a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32717079/ef7a690b8ee82f748765ed527d375c3a012ff168.png

Controls support
Now, in version 1.3.0, the game has native support for Xbox 360, Xbox One, Playtation 2, 3 and 4 controls, Gamepads and most generic controls on the market. To bring the most comfortable player experience, we have implemented a complete and effective recognition system for recognizing the drivers for each control. Vibration functionality has also been implemented, if the control is compatible with this functionality.

Optimization
A strict polishing and optimization work was done in the game's programming. At the time the game was released, I didn't have the programming experience that I have today, so an evaluation and correction work was done for each game script.

Linux
For now, the game will only support 64-bit versions of Linux, but we are already working to resolve this issue as soon as possible.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/855850/Space_Elite_Force/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1204470/Space_Elite_Force_II/

I hope you enjoy these improvements, your feedback is very important. Thanks!

Att,
Alysson Moraes - Developer.

notes.title: Space Elite Force II - Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/52c619aa59051335d6675010e23dd831de15479c.png
First game update brings some improvements to the default control settings, menu navigation and a map of the keyboard controls.

The game underwent rigorous tests in the recognition and remapping of controls, the tests were made with an Xbox One controller (Xinput) and generic Playstation 2. Some problems like starting with the inverted joystick axis have been resolved, but nothing very serious has been found.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/8b2354b8418700a6f6ba0259730d549312a7e0e1.jpg

Now, in the controls remap menu, a map of the keyboard controls will appear, if the chosen player has no control assigned to him.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/928f03fc2cd681e2698edabcbdcd82b1ff88aa8e.jpg

The navigation in side menus has also been improved, now you use buttons with 'Q' and 'E', RB and LB to navigate between the menus, this made navigation easier and easier to understand.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/6b0413a1eaa7f231621726a5bf93cee691da26da.jpg

We will continue to improve according to player feedback.

Att,
Alysson Moraes - Developer.

notes.title: Space Elite Force - Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/0448d28329deb6ef3f50d42ceeb4281f05777890.png
Using the keyboard

We've improved the way you can play using the keyboard, in previous versions you were required to play using only one key pattern to play with the keyboard, but some players were not comfortable playing in that pattern. Now you can play using one of the classic keyboard patterns in spaceship games, check out the new patterns.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/17f9cbf7d2a727ad7cd2cd5a2bf1d56b356c5224.png

You do not have to do anything at all to modify this, the game will know if you are using the as WASD ’keys or the arrow keys and will show the respective weapons use buttons on the weapons panel. This applies to the game's CO-OP mode if player 2 is using the keyboard.

Achievement “Top 5”.
Before it was necessary to be in the top five of the rank in infinite mode. Now you need to get a fixed amount to unlock this achievement, as soon as you reach 1,000,000 points in infinite mode, the achievement will be unlocked regardless of your rank position. We believe this is the fairest way for all players, everyone will have the same goal to unlock this achievement.

Improved game textures.
In previous versions the game compressed the textures of the game, leaving them with a little low quality. This ends up unnoticed for some players, but see the comparison:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/0ff8343ade92d99ecb80b4dfc7f40259156ae732.png

This is just an example of how the game was losing graphics quality, now all the textures of the game are top quality. Don't worry, it just increased the file size, the minimum requirements to play it remain the same.

Game optimization.
- Optimization work has also been done on this release to try to bring the best possible experience for the player. We resolved several programming errors that caused the game to drop FPS, in more extreme cases, the game crashed, forcing the player to restart it. We believe this bug has been resolved as we have removed and improved many things in the game's programming, but we always count on your feedback to let us know of any issues you encounter.
- Modifications have been made to balance the game, the prices of some items in the ship's upgrade menu have been changed, making the experience a bit more challenging and balanced.

I will always try to improve and develop better games, I count on your support. Thank you!

Regards,
Alysson Moraes - Developer

notes.title: Update (v 1.1.0)
notes.content:
Nothing better than calling your friend, sit on the couch and play that good old spaceship game! Version 1.1.0 brings Co-op mode to the game. Co-op mode will work in traditional modes that are Normal, Infinity and Hardcore. In order for the multiplayer mode to work you will need to have at least one Joystick connected, so the first player will use the joystick and the second will use the keyboard. But it is totally possible to play with two joysticks, having the option to customize the second joystick in the options menu.
 
https://media.giphy.com/media/3osxCxb3JCriQh5mBC/giphy.gif

A warning will appear blinking at the top of the screen when Co-op mode is available and to activate it, simply press the 'Start' or 'Enter' button on the keyboard in any of the 3 game modes and the second player will appear immediately in blue color, then just play! like in the classics :)

What's New in Version:
• Play with a friend with one or two joysticks.
• Customization of second player buttons.
• You can customize the two ships by purchasing weapons.
• Teamwork matters, Bosses are harder in Co-op mode.
• Bosses adapt to Co-op mode.

Requirements for Co-op mode:
• You must have at least one Joystick connected to the computer!
• It is recommended to disable settings for the control's desktop on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/855850/Space_Elite_Force/

I believe that the Co-op mode has brought a new experience to the game, playing with a friend in a traditional way like in the old consoles is a unique experience, bringing good moments and strengthening the friendship of the players. I will try to improve Space Elite Force more and will continue to work hard to bring good games into the future. I hope you enjoy Co-op mode and have fun with your interplanetary battle partner! Remember to leave your support analyzing the game so I can know if they are liking or hating the game =)

[code]I do not speak English very well, let me know if there is any mistake or misused word. thank you![/code]

Regards,
Alysson Moraes - Developer.

notes.title: Update (v 1.0.7)
notes.content:
Some corrections and modifications to improve the game. In this update, I took advantage to meet some requests from the players that I found most relevant to improve the game, also resolved some bugs.

- Resolved Bugs:

When the menu is displayed the default button does not display different coloring from the others.
Music and sound effects continue to play even if the volume is set to 0.
Game crashes when Player and Boss die at the same time.
Impossible to exit infinite mode.

Some bugs mentioned by you were not found in the tests, but the work to find and fix them will not stop.

- Modifications:

The secondary weapons skilltree has been modified, you can now unlock the Mines and Robotic Bees by purchasing the second item.
The prices of some store items have been changed to balance the game.
Bosses' life increases 1/6 of the total in Hardcore mode and they get furious more easily.

I'm still analyzing possible changes in infinite mode to make it more different from other modes, maybe this will be implemented in an upcoming update.

That's it for now! Keep sending suggestions and remember to leave your feedback in the game, this is very important to me! Thank you!

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
I made a great improvement in the game suggested by you! you can now access the Garage to change weapons in the game over menu. This feature is only available in normal mode, it does not make sense to implement this in Hardcore mode and Infinity mode already has something similar.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32717079/036dcab2e7375ba1554e80179f749fe2862f7f7a.png

The amount of orbs to buy the items in the garage is the same amount that the mission starts, if you start the stage with 50 orbs and die with 150 orbs, it is only worth the initial 50 orbs. This is to balance the game, so theoretically you can only buy new weapons by defeating a boss.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32717079/036dcab2e7375ba1554e80179f749fe2862f7f7a.png

For the moment that's it, I did not find any bug in the game to be fixed. I count on your feedback. Thank you!

notes.title: Update (v 1.0.3)
notes.content:
Small corrections to improve the game were made, no serious bugs have been found so far. The changes are:
• Problem with game U.I at lower resolutions
• Score distribution by defeated enemy: some enemies did not distribute the Score as they should when defeated, we arranged it!

These are minor fixes that make a big difference in the game. Have a good time!

Thanks.

notes.title: Update (v 1.0.2)
notes.content:
In this update we made some more corrections in the game and one of the achievements was changed to balance a little more the game.

Bugs fixed:
• The "Continue" button remains available even after defeating the last boss (the button is deactivated as soon as the last boss is defeated)
• Ship will not fire if you press both firing buttons at the same time.

Changes:
• Achieving "Number One" could become an almost impossible task for some players. So we changed it to "Top 5", so players in the top 5 will unlock the achievement, making it fairer for newbies (it's the same achievement, only the name and icon have changed)

Extras:
• We are still working on the problem solving of some players, we will do our best to correct this as soon as possible.

That's it for now! Keep sending in suggestions and reporting bugs in the game. Thank you!
